Synopsis:
    Norway's King Harald V was laid to rest in Oslo on September 9, following 13 days of national mourning. The state funeral drew large crowds and numerous foreign dignitaries, including royals and heads of state. Notable attendance included Ukraine's President Zelenskiy, who met with Norway's PM on the sidelines. Family controversies surrounded the event, including Queen Mette-Marit's post-transplant recovery and her son Marius Borg Hoiby's presence despite a rape and domestic violence conviction. Public support for the Norwegian monarchy remains strong at 72%.
